caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally placed object resembling an antique oil lamp with a detailed and ornate design. The lamp features a bulbous, rounded glass reservoir at the top, which is clear with shading to indicate transparency and reflections. From the top of this reservoir emerge two dark, rectangular wicks set in a narrow, circular metal collar. The body of the lamp beneath the reservoir has a sculpted appearance, transitioning into a twisted and fluted stem that continues downward into a baluster form, composed of stacked, rounded segments. The base is broad and square, decorated with symmetrical patterns and carved motifs in a gray color, resembling an engraved or cast metal. The colors of the object are primarily shades of gray and brown, with the background being a plain, pale beige or tan. There is a light brownish staining or discoloration on parts of the background. The signature “VAN SILVAY” is written in small letters at the bottom right of the image. The entire composition is centered with ample negative space surrounding the lamp.
title: Whale Oil Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
